Excellent Experience at PC Chandra Jewellers, Koramangala!

I recently visited PC Chandra Jewellers in Koramangala and had a truly wonderful experience purchasing a men's gold band ring, women's gold pola, and a pair of baby earrings.

From the moment I stepped into the showroom, the ambiance was welcoming and elegant. The staff were incredibly attentive, knowledgeable, and patient. They took the time to understand my preferences and showed me a diverse range of designs for each item.

I highly recommend PC Chandra Jewellers Koramangala to anyone looking for exquisite gold jewelry and a delightful shopping experience. Their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction truly stands out.

I  visited the shop  today and was assisted by Manash Baanagerji. The service was excellent from start to finish. He was professional, knowledgeable, and very patient in helping me choose the right item.

What impressed me most was how the shop handled an exchange. I needed to return and exchange an item I had purchased, and the staff, including Manash, were very understanding and cooperative. They managed the situation calmly and respectfully, without any frustration or hesitation, which made me feel truly valued as a customer.

This level of customer service is rare and deeply appreciated. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking to buy gold/ Diamonds  with confidence.

We went to PC Chandra Jewellers, Koramangala shop for buying wedding jewellery. We had a very good experience as always, great collection, and to top it all such warm assistance from the staff. Rajdeep was very helpful and kind in helping us plan our buy and with insights on products n purchase plans. We came out very happy n satisfied.

The experience of buying jewellery from this branch has been nothing short of amazing! The staff were very friendly, guided us throughout the process from suggesting the right choice of jewellery to further support. I would suggest anyone who is looking to buy gold to come visit this store at Koramangala.

Very good experience. Sagar Dey has helped us in selecting the perfect jewellery. Very polite and helpful. Nice collection. If you are looking for Bengali jewelleries in Bangalore must come in Koramangala showroom.
Lavanya and sutanoy Samir all are outstanding host explained everything in details
Good experience with pc chandra jwellers
